about_the_game:
Aniverse is a 2D top-down survival game where you play as a conscious fox exploring a procedural world full of wildlife, various biomes and creative possibilities.

Power of Music

In Aniverse, music is more than expression,  it is interaction, influence and even survival.

Animals react to different musical styles. Some instruments can stun enemies, boost crop growth or even change the weather. 

Progress through Decoration

Your shelter is more than a base, it's a canvas.

Decorating with furniture and items earns you visual points that unlock new crafting stations and upgrades. Progression is tied to style and creativity, not just grinding.


Meals that matter

Cooking is not just about staying fed. Meals can grant passive buffs, reflect projectiles or enhance your skills in unexpected ways. Every food has a purpose and some are the key to survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX1050 / RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Chop trees, cook meals, build your home and play music to control the wild! Explore a procedurally generated world and survive your way through art.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Spanish - Spain, Russian
